title: parse_range silently coerces unparseable article number to 0
description: reader/session/command.rs:250-264: parse_range uses unwrap_or(0) for invalid integer tokens, turning 'abc-def' into ArticleRange::Range(0, 0). The behavior is safe (session returns 423 for nonexistent article 0), but reading parse_range in isolation the fallback is invisible. A contributor copying this pattern elsewhere may produce a range that silently truncates to 0 in a context where 0 is valid. Fix: add a comment: '// Invalid token: default to 0, which will return 423 No Such Article' or return a ParseError.
